items.text: Season 24 launches September 23, 2026!
[p align="start"]NEW THIS SEASON

Honor Duels: Starting with Season 24, during a match you can challenge another player to a 1v1, played in the same match type you are currently playing. Once an Honor Duel is accepted, all other players will be invited to spectate the match. The challenger and defender will automatically be moved into the Honor Duel when the current match is finished, and spectators can accept the notification in the Social Menu to see the Duel.
Black Market Trade-Ins: Players can now trade-in 3 Duplicate Black Market Items to acquire a new Black Market item.
Winner Celebration MVP Goal Explosions: The match MVP’s equipped Goal Explosion now plays on the podium screen, with the explosion name shown on screen.

New Bullet Ball LTM: Last car standing wins this high-stakes arena battle! A fast-moving, homing ball targets a single player. The ball will demolish its target on impact, unless you flip into the ball.
Stat Incrementing Titles: Certain Titles can now track and display specific stats, and new visuals can be unlocked as milestones are passed.

Custom Scoreboards: You can now select which stats show up on the in-game scoreboard on a per-mode basis. Shots, Saves, and Assists can now be changed to Demos, High Fives, Flip Resets, or many other in-game events.
Top 100 Titles: Added new Titles for players in the Top 100 of the global Soccar leaderboards, granted at the end of the season.

Modernized Keyboard and Mouse Controls: A brand new free look camera mode has been added with updated Mouse and Keyboard control defaults. Players can now also enable a center dot reticule to support the new camera movement. The free look camera mode is available to controller players as well.
[p align="start"]CHANGES AND UPDATES
[p align="start"]Playlists and Modes
Free-for-all modes, including Bullet Ball and Knockout, can now be selected in Private Matches and Exhibition.
Added a Boost Pad Recharge Rate mutator.
[p align="start"]BUG FIXES
[p align="start"]Playlists and Modes
Free-for-all modes, including Bullet Ball and Knockout, can now be selected in Private Matches and Exhibition.
Added a Boost Pad Recharge Rate mutator.
[p align="start"]BUG FIXES
[p align="start"]Stability and Performance
Fixed an issue on PC where alt-tabbing during a transition would leave the client frozen on the previous frame.
Fixed an issue on PlayStation 5 where the front end was invisible after booting into Rocket League from rest mode.
Fixed a crash on consoles that could occur on boot when a cooked package was missing.
Fixed a crash in the main menu preview.
[p align="start"]UI and Menus
Stats API: Fixed the GoalScored event not triggering in replays.
Stats API: A match that ends in no contest now reports -1 as the winning team.
Fixed an issue on Nintendo Switch where Item Shop bundle tile thumbnails did not load.
Fixed an issue where the Crate Preview screen cut off the fourth row of items.
Fixed an issue where Rocket Pass toasts would sometimes fail to dismiss.
Fixed overlapping buttons and incorrect tab desaturation in the Shop when navigating with a controller.
[p align="start"]Cosmetics and Content
Fixed an issue on PC where the SMAA anti-aliasing option did not smooth jagged edges as intended.
Fixed an issue where big boost pickups would flicker on the High quality setting.
Fixed an issue with vehicle descriptions for Reactive and Cross-Entitled items.
Fixed an issue where the Blue Chip Rocket Boost displayed an overly bright bloom effect in the Item Shop and Main Menu.
Fixed an issue where cars would spawn into the ground in mirrored Training Packs.

Version: Rocket League v2.72
[p align="start"]Scheduled Release: August 4, 2026 4 PM PT / August 4, 2026 11 PM UTC
Kickoff spawn change: the team down a player will now always spawn in an advantageous position on kickoff to challenge the opponent.
Snow Day and Rumble Free Play maps can now be played as Soccar.
Stats API: Added WebSocket support, and commands can now be issued to the game to perform various actions. Full details will be published on the Rocket League website when this update goes live.
Improved the Rich Presence details shown on Xbox.
Post Party support has been removed.
Players with Streamer Mode enabled will now be added to the recent players tab at the end of the match instead of the beginning.
Anonymized players will now have their profile vanity items (Banner, Title, Avatar) hidden.
Reduced occurrences of "Error 71" in Ranked Doubles.
Reduced the crash rate on Nintendo Switch.
Improved rendering on consoles.
Adjusted lighting on the Futura Main Menu.
Fixed an issue where players were unable to launch the game after a recent update (the Easy Anti-Cheat popup would briefly appear, then close).
Fixed a crash/freeze on PC that could occur when opening Settings or starting Training or Free Play.
Fixed a client crash on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 that could occur while loading saved user data.
Fixed a crash on Nintendo Switch 2 that occurred when scrolling the Body section of the Garage.
Fixed a crash on PlayStation 5 that occurred when loading item thumbnails in the Garage.
Fixed an issue where players could spawn on the wrong side of the field after being demolished.
Fixed an issue where player names could be missing from the list when joining a matchmaking game.
Fixed missing teammate/opponent anonymization in several parts of gameplay while Streamer Mode is enabled.
Fixed an issue where a teammate's Steam profile picture could appear on their score banner while Streamer Mode was enabled.
Fixed several Goal Explosions clipping into the floor on Loophole, Dunk House, and The Block.
Fixed lighting on some Decals appearing different in the Shop and Garage than in-game.
Fixed an issue where the Bitcrush Rocket Boost always displayed a lens flare effect when equipped.
Fixed pixelated field lines near the player on several maps.
Fixed an issue where the goal frame was visible through the Chomp Goal Explosion.
Fixed an issue where the two figures in the "Demigodly" Goal Explosion did not finish their animation at the same time.
Fixed an issue where the HUD (player info and bottom menu bar) could reappear after being hidden during gameplay.
Fixed Rich Presence on Xbox not updating in the in-game social menu.
Fixed the Esports button incorrectly showing a "NO WINNER YET" World Cup label (and overlapping) when no World Cup was configured.
Fixed placeholder text on an event Challenge reward.
Fixed a Special FX glyph being cut off at the bottom in Replays.
Fixed an issue where the carousel above the Main Menu could clip beyond its window.
Fixed the Replay camera showing a Director angle outside the field when viewing pre-Update 59 Replays on Parc de Paris.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9036925/0c17dd046e7a088407a2204ab9a1f0579175897f.jpg"]
Version: Rocket League v2.66
⁠Platforms: Epic Games Store, Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo
⁠Scheduled Release: March 10, 2026 4 PM PT / March 11, 2026 12 AM UTC
Playlist Population Numbers
Flip Reset Indicator
Visible Matchmaking Rating (MMR)
Boost Timer Visualization
Override Boost Audio Option
Nintendo Switch DLC Update
New Quick Chats
Custom Training Settings Update
Queue Menu Changes
[p align="start"]Playlist Population Numbers
[p align="start"]Good news, everyone! A really great feature has made its return, and it’s an amazing day to check the queues.
[p align="start"]Playlist Population is once again visible in the Play Menu.
View total Rocket League player population.
See playlist-specific population when you’re hovering on a mode.
[p align="start"]Now you’ll know exactly how packed the pitch is before you queue up.
[img src="https://us-west-2-epicgames.graphassets.com/cmkr1i7c9047e07n0es5291ez/cmmf1p9mrj00j07n0rxhgogfs"]
[p align="start"]Flip Reset Indicator

[p align="start"]We’ve introduced a new audio and visual cue to signal when a player has achieved a flip reset, which is when the player has regained their dodge by touching the ball with three or more wheels.
The visual effect is designed as a quick burst to reinforce the moment of reset without disrupting gameplay clarity.
The flip reset indicator is only visible/audible to the player performing the flip reset or for spectators, but appears for all players during replays, when the option is enabled.
You can disable the flip reset indicator in the settings.
Disabling the flip reset indicator also turns off the effect while you spectate.
[p align="start"]Visible Matchmaking Rating (MMR)
[p align="start"]Players now have the option to choose to display their MMR in Competitive Playlists. Enable this option in the settings to:
Show your MMR on Competitive Playlist tiles.
Display MMR on the scoreboard at the end of Ranked Matches.
[p align="start"]This setting does not affect Casual Playlists.
[p align="start"]Boost Timer Visualization
[p align="start"]Large boost pads now display a visual recharge indicator so you can play more strategically.
Large boost pads take 10 seconds to respawn, with the visual indicator gradually refilling over those 10 seconds until the pad is fully recharged.
[img src="https://us-west-2-epicgames.graphassets.com/cmkr1i7c9047e07n0es5291ez/cmmfmtgo83zui07obelt20jb2"]
[p align="start"]Override Boost Audio Option
[p align="start"]Players can now set the default, Standard Boost sound to any Boost they have equipped.
The Override Boost Audio check box can be found in the Audio tab in the settings.
Only affects your in-match audio, not replays or menus. Other players will still hear the sound associated with the equipped Boost.
[p align="start"]Nintendo Switch DLC Update

[p align="start"]If you bought Rocket League DLC on Nintendo Switch or Nintendo Switch 2, you’ll now have it on other platforms that the DLC is available on. Just make sure your platform accounts are connected to your Epic account.
[p align="start"]New Quick Chats
[p align="start"]We’ve added several new Quick Chats to give players more ways to communicate in-game.
Informational
“One more”
“Back Post”
“Leaving”
“Oops, wrong quickchat!”
Reactions
“Unlucky”
“This isn’t Rocket League”
“Oof”
“Be careful!”
“Let’s lock in”
“Brutal!” has replaced “Savage!”
Apologies
“All good!”
[p align="start"]Jump in and let your teammates (and opponents 👀) know exactly what you’re thinking.
[p align="start"]Custom Training Settings Update
[p align="start"]In Custom Training, new adjustable randomization options create more dynamic scenarios, helping players refine mechanics and build adaptability in unpredictable situations.
[p align="start"]These options can be found by opening Custom Training, playing a custom training pack, then opening the settings.
Ball Speed Modifier (0%–100%, Default: 0%)
Applies random variance to the ball’s initial speed.
For example, at 50%, the ball’s speed can randomly increase by up to 50% or decrease by up to 50%.
Ball Location Modifier (0–1000, Default: 0)
Randomizes the ball’s spawn location within a radial distance from its original position.
Ball Height Modifier (0–1000, Default: 0)
Applies a random vertical offset to the ball’s spawn position.
Ball may spawn higher or lower within the defined range.
Vehicle Location Modifier (0–1000, Default: 0)
Randomizes the vehicle’s spawn location within a radial distance from its original position.
Vehicle Rotation Modifier (0°–100°, Default: 0°)
Applies a random rotation variance to the vehicle’s starting orientation.
For example, if you choose 30°, the vehicle’s forward direction will vary between -30° and +30° from the original setup.
Spawn Vehicle on Ground (Default: On)
When enabled, the vehicle spawns grounded.
When disabled, the vehicle spawns using legacy Custom Training behavior (a little bit above the ground).
Skip Goal Replay
When enabled, goal replays are skipped during Custom Training.
Round Start Input Delay (0–0.1 seconds, Default: 0)
Changes how immediate a round begins after detecting player input
0 seconds allows for faster, more immediate control at the start of each round.
0.1 seconds is the legacy Custom Training behavior.
[p align="start"]Queue Menu Changes
[p align="start"]The menu displayed while searching for a match has been updated to better support players who want to stay in gameplay-focused activities while queued.
“Freeplay” and “Challenges” now replace “Item Shop” and “Garage” in the Queue Menu. “Training” remains unchanged.
“Freeplay”
Instantly loads Freeplay on your last selected map, no confirmation required.
“Challenges”
Opens directly to the first tab of the Challenges menu, serving as a quick-access shortcut while queued.
“Claim” notifications won’t be displayed.
[p align="start"]Gameplay
Removed an unintended piece of wall graffiti in The Block (Hoops) that obscured visibility of the net.
Fixed an issue where the cage on Beckwith Park Arena’s variants could obstruct the player’s view.
Fixed an issue that could prevent Custom Tournaments from being created.
Fixed an issue where the in-match notification feed displayed duplicate messages during a demolition.
On Nintendo Switch, fixed an issue where the Play Again button would occasionally not appear in the Post-Match Menu after a Competitive match.
Fixed an issue where a Rumble power-up could be granted too early when using a power-up soon after getting demolished.
[p align="start"]Cosmetic
Fixed an issue where the Magnifique Car Body Trim color would override selected paint colors and finishes.
Fixed an issue where applying certain Decals caused the rear panel of the McLaren P1 to appear white.
Fixed an issue where the Deep Space Trail did not consistently appear during goal replays.
Fixed an issue where the Gravity Bomb Goal Explosion would demolish cars.
[p align="start"]KNOWN ISSUES
[p align="start"]For a complete list of known issues in Rocket League, check out our Known Issues page.

Cartman’s Crash Out LTE
Expanded Preset Slots
Champions Field Update
Skip New Player Tutorial
Nintendo Switch 2 Rendering Enhancements
[p align="start"]Cartman’s Crash Out LTE

From January 22 at 4 PM PT to February 5 at 4 PM PT, jump into the Cartman’s Crash Out limited-time event and complete Challenges to score new Certified Toppers, and the animated Cheesy Poofs Octane Decal.
[p align="start"]Expanded Preset Slots
We’ve expanded preset slots from 50 to 75, giving room for more custom combos! Mix and match items and turn them into ready-to-go rides.
[p align="start"]Champions Field update
To honor and celebrate the 2025 RLCS 3v3 champions Atomic, BeastMode, Daniel, and Satthew — and the 1v1 champion Nwpo — banners for them have been added to the Champions Field Arena.
[p align="start"]Skip New Player Tutorial
Players who have already completed the introductory tutorial will no longer be forced back into it when playing on another platform for the first time (excluding Xbox).
[p align="start"]Nintendo Switch 2 Rendering Enhancements
We’ve made a series of visual and performance improvements for Rocket League on Nintendo Switch 2.
Simplified Graphics Settings
The Performance/Quality toggle has been removed, as Rocket League on Nintendo Switch 2 now uses the best of both settings.
Improved Resolution
Docked mode: Resolution is now locked at 1080p, 60 FPS in docked mode.
Handheld mode: Dynamic resolution now targets 1080p at 60 FPS, but will still reduce resolution as needed to keep gameplay smooth.
Visual Quality Upgrades
Increased world detail
Higher texture quality in handheld mode, matching docked mode
Crisper texture detail with increased anisotropic filtering (reduces jagged lines and blurry edges on surfaces)
Improved lighting effects
Ambient occlusion
Higher-resolution shadows
[p align="start"]Visual
Fixed taillight brightness appearing inconsistent across multiple Car Bodies.
The Heatwave Decal now displays correctly on Lamborghini Urus.
Fixed an issue where the RLCS ’25 and RLCS ’26 Decals appeared stretched on the hood of the Fennec ZR-F Car Body.
Fixed an issue where the Chanoir Octane Decal could override the Car Body’s painted trim.
Fixed an issue where the large screens in Champions Field could display distorted visuals.
[p align="start"]Audio
Fixed an issue where BMW M4 GT3 Evo’s engine audio was louder than intended.
Fixed an issue where the Patty Wagon Car Body used the incorrect engine audio during gameplay.
Fixed an issue where sound effects for the Hologlass Goal Explosion could cut off when triggered during gameplay.
[p align="start"]For a complete list of known issues in Rocket League, check out our Known Issues page.

Challenge Updates
Rank Updates

[p align="start"]New Rocket Pass
The Season 21 Rocket Pass is here, featuring the Corlay, Magnifique and Magnifique GXT Car Bodies!
Corlay uses the Octane hitbox, and Magnifique and Magnifique GXT use the Dominus hitbox.
Drops have also returned in the Rocket Pass past Tier 70, as free rewards.
[p align="start"]Challenge Updates
Season 21 Stage 1 Challenges are live.
One extra Drop will be added to every Challenge Stage.
As the final reward for completing all Challenge Stages, the Challenge Competition Boost will be replaced with a set of 1 Special Drop, 1 Deluxe Drop, and 1 Import Drop.
A repeatable Drops Challenge is available in the Weekly Challenges lineup. Win 10 Online Matches in any Competitive mode to unlock a Sport Drop, Special Drop, AND Deluxe Drop per completion.
[p align="start"]Ranked Updates
For Season 21, Ranked Snowday replaces Ranked Dropshot, and Dropshot moves to the Casual Playlist rotation.
Similar to previous Seasons, a soft rank reset has been applied to all Ranked Playlists.
In order to address feedback, ranked Quads stay for another season.

We’ve made a number of under-the-hood changes to Quads based on its rollout in Season 20 (more details are in “Improvements for Ranked Quads and Heatseeker” below) and we’ll continue to monitor matchmaking health throughout Season 21 to determine whether Ranked Quads stays beyond this season.
[p align="start"]Tournament Updates
Season 21 tournaments are live.
Any unspent Season 20 Tournament Credits have been automatically converted into rewards.
Tournament Credits are converted into the highest-level reward(s) you’re capable of earning based on your Tournament Rank and the amount of Tournament Credits you have remaining.
Every player who played in at least one tournament in Season 20 will receive one All-Star Cup!
New Tournament Reward items have been added!
[p align="start"]New Arena: Parc de Paris
Check out the Parc de Paris Arena, now live!
[p align="start"]Addition to 4v4 Arena Rotation
We also added a new arena to the Quads rotation: Mannfield (Quads).

We've seen the feedback about how visibility on the existing Quads maps is challenging due to lack of objects in the environment. To address this, we made an alternative Quads arena that uses the familiar Mannfield outer environment.
Although this arena does not include a grass pitch we wanted to release this version to gauge if visibility is improved.
Keep the feedback coming!
[p align="start"]Heatseeker Joins the Ranked Lineup
Heatseeker has become a fan favorite, so we’re cranking things up and officially adding it to the Ranked Playlist lineup.
Ranked Heatseeker launches exclusively in the 2v2 format.
Heatseeker Grand Champion and Heatseeker Supersonic Legend Player Titles will be available as part of the Season 21 Ranked Rewards.
A Ranked Heatseeker leaderboard has been added.
[p align="start"]“Bring the Heat” Limited Time Event
“Bring the Heat” is live for one scorching week! Jump in to celebrate the launch of Ranked Heatseeker with Challenges and rewards, including Drops and the blistering Fire Eye Topper.
[p align="start"]Introducing Rocket Rundown
Rocket Rundown is a personalized, web-based Seasonal review that celebrates a player’s Rocket League journey with statistics, achievements, and community comparisons.
Head to rocketleague.com/rundown later this week and sign in with your Epic account to unlock your rundown of the previous Season. Players can only access their own rundown data.
After logging in, you’ll get a downloadable Season Summary Card showing off your highlights.
Sign in, check it out, and compare with friends!
[p align="start"]Community Spotlight: Kaydop
Players can claim the three-time World Champion’s Player Title, “SHOT LIKE THE DOP,” for free in the Item Shop from December 10 to December 17!
[img src="https://us-west-2-epicgames.graphassets.com/cm84mjx3f0a0j08n79wol8l1l/cmixmbf3m22rl07olbx95p52j"]
[p align="start"]Free Login Rewards
Login anytime during Season 21 to snag two free Player Banners: Security Lasers and Liquid Gold.
[p align="start"]Improvements for Ranked Quads and Heatseeker
We learned a lot from launching Ranked Quads in Season 20 and took feedback from that to adjust the Ranked Quads experience in Season 21, as well as the launch of Ranked Heatseeker.
Quads
Players that are ranked Platinum I and above may see their rank increase at the beginning of Season 21.
Reasoning: In Season 20, our placement logic for Quads often gave higher-skilled players lower-than-expected starting ranks and resulted in weaker matchmaking quality.

For Season 21, initial placement now uses skill mappings from other playlists when no prior 4v4 data exists. This update provides more accurate starting ranks for higher-skilled players and improves overall matchmaking quality.
Because of this adjustment, more players will likely reach the higher ranks, improving matchmaking times at those ranks.
Heatseeker
Ranked Heatseeker will use the same rank placement that Quads now does.
Also, the overall rank distribution for Heatseeker should create a healthy, accurate spread across all skill levels.

[p align="start"]18 universal Decals representing some of the teams competing in RLCS 2026 are available in the RLCS Shop. Select the “RLCS Shop” tab and support your favorites!
